steps.title: Adjust cell and contig barcodes
steps.instruction: Add user‑supplied suffixes and/or prefixes to cell and contig barcodes so that no barcodes overlap between samples.

steps.title: Re‑annotate contigs with igblastn
steps.instruction: Run igblastn (v1.19.0) against the IMGT reference sequences to re‑annotate all contigs.

steps.title: Re‑annotate D and J genes with blastn
steps.instruction: Run blastn separately on D and J genes using parameters dust=no, word size J=7, word size D=9; set e‑value cutoff J=10⁻⁴ (instead of igblastn default 10) and D=10⁻³ to enable annotation of contigs lacking a V gene.

steps.title: Recover non‑overlapping J gene segments
steps.instruction: From the all_contig_j_blast.tsv file, select the J gene with the highest j_support score; iteratively select the next highest j_support whose j_sequence_start and j_sequence_end do not overlap any previously selected J gene until the list is exhausted. For contigs without V annotations, choose the leftmost 5′ J gene and update the j_call column in the final AIRR table; for contigs with V annotations but multiple J calls, retain the igblastn annotations.

steps.title: Re‑annotate heavy‑chain constant region
steps.instruction: Run blastn (v2.13.0) against curated CH1 sequences of the appropriate isotype class to re‑annotate heavy‑chain constant (C) region calls.

steps.title: Correct heavy‑chain V gene alleles
steps.instruction: Apply TIgGER (v1.0.0) to correct heavy‑chain V‑gene allele calls, then parse the final outputs into AIRR format using change‑o scripts.

steps.title: Perform cell‑level quality control
steps.instruction: Use Dandelion’s check_contig function to verify consistent V, D, J, and C gene calls; sort contigs by UMI count and prioritize productive contigs; flag cells with orphan, extra pair(s), or ambiguous status (allowing IgM and IgD together if no other isotypes are present); apply library‑type restrictions to discard contigs annotated to unexpected loci; run filter_contigs to ensure each cell has at most one VDJ and one VJ pair (or only an orphan VDJ), removing any contigs that fail these checks.

steps.title: Save QC‑passed rearrangements
steps.instruction: Write all rearrangement sequences that pass the standard quality‑control checks to a file whose name ends with the suffix "_contig_dandelion.tsv".

steps.title: Group BCRs into clones/clonotypes
steps.instruction: Apply a rule‑based procedure to productive rearrangements: after cell‑level QC each cell contributes at most one dominant productive VDJ and one productive VJ contig (selected by UMI count). Perform chain‑aware grouping by separating heavy‑ and light‑chain repertoires and defining paired clonotypes using the combined heavy+light signature. Require identical V‑gene and J‑gene calls, identical CDR3 amino‑acid length, and ≥85% CDR3 amino‑acid identity (Hamming‑distance criterion). For cells lacking an unambiguous productive chain, use the available chain only and exclude them from analyses that need paired heavy+light definitions. Generate clonotype frequency tables, summarize clone‑size distributions, and compute repertoire diversity metrics (Shannon entropy and/or Simpson diversity) on depth‑normalized tables.

steps.title: Quantify basic mutation load
steps.instruction: Run Dandelion’s pp.quantify_mutations (a wrapper of SHaZam) to sum all mutation scores—including silent and replacement mutations for both heavy and light chains—per cell.
